What the fuck. Did. You. Do. Straying from optimal operation lines — killing non-targets — is dangerous. I just want to remind you who you work for. <strong>FANG</> is infamous the world over, spoken of highly in all the darkest corners and most secure rooms. The higher-ups have connects so deep they might as well be bloodlines. You've, you've threatened many lives with your carelessness, and now, your own. Deal with the consequences.

These consequences, our informants report, come in the form of a specialized <strong>UICS</> sniper, known as <strong>MONSTERA</>. Monstera’s role is to hunt down anomalies. Spies. You.
